FN-YA002N-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 262
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator William Beasley
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 05/02/2023
Senate Bill 262 as introduced appropriates $13,151,435 from the Education Trust Fund to
Tuskegee University for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2024. In addition, this bill requires
at least $2,000,000 of this appropriation to be expended for the agricultural research and
extension service state match.

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 262
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Senator William Beasley
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 05/18/2023
Senate Bill 262 as passed the Senate would appropriate $13,651,435 from the Education Trust
Fund to Tuskegee University for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2024. In addition, this bill
would require at least $2 million of this appropriation to be expended for the agricultural
research and extension service state match.
